def clean(df):
    # Fix duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix negative flipper lengths
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Fix out of range flipper lengths
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Fix body_mass_g text numbers
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Fix sex label variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    return {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in result.items()}
